national.title: How to Update Aadhaar Card Address, Mobile Number, and Details (2026)
national.summary: Step-by-step guide to updating your Aadhaar address online or updating mobile number and biometrics at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra. Verified UIDAI statutory fees of ₹50 for demographic updates and complete document guidelines.

steps.title: Log in to myAadhaar Portal with OTP
steps.description: Visit myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number and captcha, and log in using the OTP sent to your linked phone.
steps.calloutText: Online update requires receiving an authentication SMS on the phone number currently linked to your Aadhaar.

steps.title: Choose Update Type: Online Address or Kendra Appointment
steps.description: Select 'Address Update' for direct online paperless change. Select 'Book an Appointment' if updating mobile number, name, or biometrics.

steps.title: Enter New Residential Address Details
steps.description: Fill in house number, street, landmark, area, pin code, district, and state in English and your regional language.
steps.calloutText: Ensure automated translation into the regional language matches your official local documentation.

steps.title: Select and Upload Supporting Address Document
steps.description: Choose a valid document such as an electricity bill, bank passbook, or voter card. Upload a clear PDF or JPEG under 2 MB.

steps.title: Pay Government Demographic Update Fee Online
steps.description: Pay the statutory ₹50 fee online. Note that UIDAI occasionally offers free online address updates during promotional periods.
steps.where: Integrated Payment Gateway (UPI / Net Banking / Card)

steps.title: Save Update Request Number (URN) for Tracking
steps.description: Download the PDF acknowledgment slip containing your 14-digit Update Request Number (URN) and transaction receipt.
steps.calloutText: Use your 14-digit URN to check verification progress anytime on myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in.

steps.title: Visit Kendra with Token (Only for Mobile / Biometrics)
steps.description: If updating your mobile number, photo, or iris, visit the Kendra at your booked slot. No physical visit is needed for online address updates.

steps.title: Download Updated e-Aadhaar After Approval
steps.description: Once UIDAI verification approves your request, download your password-protected digital e-Aadhaar or order a plastic PVC card.

documentRequirements.name: Valid Proof of Address (PoA)
documentRequirements.description: Electricity bill (less than 3 months old), water bill, gas connection bill, or bank passbook with photo and address.
documentRequirements.copiesHint: Clear color scan in PDF or JPEG format

documentRequirements.name: Valid Proof of Identity (PoI)
documentRequirements.description: PAN card, voter ID, passport, or driving licence required when updating name or personal identity details.

documentRequirements.name: Proof of Date of Birth (PoB)
documentRequirements.description: Birth certificate issued by municipal authority, school leaving certificate, or passport for date of birth correction.

documentRequirements.name: Head of Family (HoF) Consent Form
documentRequirements.description: Self-declaration by head of family along with proof of relationship when updating address without an independent document.

documentRequirements.name: Standard Certificate by Gazetted Officer
documentRequirements.description: Official UIDAI standard certificate template with photograph signed and stamped by an authorized group A gazetted officer.

documentRequirements.name: Existing Aadhaar Card or Number
documentRequirements.description: Original physical Aadhaar letter, PVC card, or 12-digit Aadhaar number for authentication.

rejectionReasons.title: Blurry or Incomplete Proof of Address Document
rejectionReasons.description: Uploading a cropped photo where the name, address, or issuing authority seal is obscured leads to rejection.
rejectionReasons.solution: Scan the full original document in high contrast showing all four corners and official seals.

rejectionReasons.title: Name Mismatch Between Proof and Aadhaar
rejectionReasons.description: If the name on your electricity bill or bank passbook differs substantially from your Aadhaar name, scrutiny fails.
rejectionReasons.solution: Use a document where your full name matches Aadhaar exactly, or update your name first.

rejectionReasons.title: Utility Bill Older Than 3 Months
rejectionReasons.description: UIDAI guidelines mandate that electricity, water, or telephone bills must be issued within the last ninety days.
rejectionReasons.solution: Download the most recent monthly electricity or gas bill before uploading.

rejectionReasons.title: Submitting Unattested Rent Agreement
rejectionReasons.description: An unregistered plain paper rent agreement or notarized copy without official stamp duty is not accepted by UIDAI.
rejectionReasons.solution: Submit a registered rent agreement or choose another recognized address document.

rejectionReasons.title: Exceeding Lifetime Update Limits for Name or DoB
rejectionReasons.description: UIDAI permits name change only twice and date of birth correction only once in a lifetime.
rejectionReasons.solution: Visit a regional UIDAI office with gazetted notification if an exceptional correction is required.

rejectionReasons.title: Mismatch in Regional Language Transliteration
rejectionReasons.description: Automated phonetic translation into the local state language may contain spelling errors that cause scrutiny rejection.
rejectionReasons.solution: Carefully edit the regional language script on screen to ensure accurate spelling before submitting.

faqItems.question: Can I update my Aadhaar address online without visiting a centre?
faqItems.answer: Yes. You can update your residential address completely online through the myAadhaar portal using OTP.

faqItems.question: Can I update my mobile number in Aadhaar online from home?
faqItems.answer: No. Mobile number updates require biometric authentication at a physical Aadhaar Seva Kendra or post office.

faqItems.question: How much does UIDAI charge to update an address or name?
faqItems.answer: The statutory government fee is ₹50 for demographic updates including address, name, gender, and date of birth.

faqItems.question: What is the fee for updating biometric details in Aadhaar?
faqItems.answer: The statutory fee is ₹100 for biometric updates, which includes photograph, fingerprints, and iris scans.

faqItems.question: Are mandatory biometric updates for children aged 5 and 15 free?
faqItems.answer: Yes. UIDAI provides mandatory biometric updates for children at ages 5 and 15 completely free of charge.

faqItems.question: How long does it take for Aadhaar details to get updated?
faqItems.answer: Most updates are processed within 7 to 15 days, and UIDAI sends an SMS confirmation upon completion.

faqItems.question: Can I update my Aadhaar address using my family head's documents?
faqItems.answer: Yes. UIDAI allows Head of Family (HoF) based address updates with relationship proof and OTP consent.

faqItems.question: How can I download my updated Aadhaar card after approval?
faqItems.answer: Visit myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in, select 'Download Aadhaar', enter your Aadhaar number, and verify with OTP.
